heads.en: Commentary on the Song of Songs

headnotes.la: Desiderantis vox est Synagogae adventum Christi. Quasi diceret: Toties mihi adventum suum promisit per prophetas, veniat ergo jam, et osculetur me osculo oris sui, id est per se ipsum mihi loquatur
headnotes.en: …if she said: So many times has he promised me his coming through the prophets; let him then come now, and let him kiss me with the kiss of his mouth, that is, let him speak to me through his very self

headnotes.la: Repente ad ipsum, cujus desiderio flagrabat, verba convertens, subdit
headnotes.en: Suddenly turning her words to him for whom she burned with desire, she adds

headnotes.la: …at; sed ubera Christi meliora sunt vino, quia dulcedo Evangelii melior est austeritate legis. In lege enim nulla reservatur poenitentia, sed praecipitur ut qui peccat occidatur: Evangelium autem dicit
headnotes.en: …n wine, because the sweetness of the Gospel is better than the severity of the law. For in the law no penance is reserved, but it is commanded that he who sins be put to death; whereas the Gospel says

headnotes.la: Unguenta sunt dona Spiritus sancti, vel etiam opiniones virtutum, de quibus Apostolus
headnotes.en: The ointments are the gifts of the Holy Spirit, or also the good reputations of the virtues, concerning which the Apostle says

headnotes.la: Nomen tuum, o Christe, effusum est. Chrisma Graece, Latine unctio, unde Christus: nomen Christi ab unctione vocatum est. Solet enim Spiritus sanctus olei nomine appellari, juxta quod Psalmista ait
headnotes.en: …*chrisma*, in Latin *unctio* (anointing), whence "Christ": the name of Christ is called from anointing. For the Holy Spirit is wont to be called by the name of oil, according to what the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: …us electis: unde et a Christo Christiani dicuntur, participio nominis Christi. Et bene non stillatum, sed effusum oleum dicitur, quia abundanter haec gratia omnibus data est fidem Christi recolentibus
headnotes.en: …ians from Christ, by participation in the name of Christ. And well is the oil said not to be dripped but poured out, because this grace has been given abundantly to all who cherish the faith of Christ

headnotes.la: Hic est permutatio personae. Nam hactenus locuta est Synagoga, hic incipit loqui Ecclesia de gentibus
headnotes.en: Here is a change of person. For up to this point the Synagogue has spoken; here the Church of the Gentiles begins to speak

headnotes.la: Quia (inquit) meam infirmitatem cognosco, et video me nihil meis viribus boni posse agere, tua gratia trahe me ad tui imitationem, vel etiam, cum coelum ascenderis, trahe me post te
headnotes.en: …she says) I know my own weakness, and I see that by my own powers I can do nothing good, by thy grace draw me to the imitation of thee; or also, when thou hast ascended into heaven, draw me after thee

headnotes.la: … loquitur de Christo sponso suo ad animas fideles. Cellaria Dei sunt aeterna beatitudo, et supernae patriae gaudia, in qua introducta est jam Ecclesia per fidem et spem, quandoque introducetur per rem
headnotes.en: …ls. The storerooms of God are eternal blessedness and the joys of the heavenly fatherland, into which the Church has already been brought by faith and hope, and one day will be brought in in very fact

headnotes.la: De donis (inquit) tuis exsultabimus et laetabimur. Sed quia scimus hoc non nostri esse meriti, in te, non in nobis exsultabimus: hoc est quod Apostolus ait
headnotes.en: In thy gifts (she says) we will exult and rejoice. But because we know that this is not of our own merit, we will exult in thee, not in ourselves: this is what the Apostle says

headnotes.la: …gratiae tuae et misericordiae tuae, qua salvati sumus. Ubera enim sunt ipsa gratia, qua salvati sumus. Recordantes etiam quia tu austeritatem legis uberibus doctrinae evangelicae temperare dignatus es
headnotes.en: … we have been saved. For the breasts are that very grace by which we have been saved. Remembering also that thou hast deigned to temper the severity of the law with the breasts of evangelical teaching

headnotes.la: …rusalem, id est animae fideles. Nigra sum, id est, deformis persecutionibus et aerumnis quas sustineo, sed formosa sum decore virtutum. Quomodo autem nigra sit, et quomodo formosa, ostendit cum subdit
headnotes.en: … am black, that is, disfigured by the persecutions and hardships which I endure, but I am beautiful with the comeliness of the virtues. And how she is black, and how beautiful, she shows when she adds

headnotes.la: … soliti sunt, et non habent domos. Dicit ergo Ecclesia se nigram esse sicut tabernacula Cedar, propter persecutiones quas patiebatur a filiis tenebrarum, quod interpretatur Cedar. Hinc Psalmista dicit
headnotes.en: …therefore says that she is black as the tents of Cedar, on account of the persecutions which she suffered from the sons of darkness, which is what Cedar is interpreted to mean. Hence the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: O animae fideles et devotae Deo,
headnotes.en: O souls faithful and devoted to God,

headnotes.la: id est quod tribulationibus afficiar, quod persecutionibus opprimar,
headnotes.en: that is, that I am afflicted with tribulations, that I am oppressed with persecutions,

headnotes.la: …bus meis pro vobis, quae est gloria vestra. Non enim sunt condignae passiones, etc. Sol autem in Scripturis multos habet sensus. Aliquando significat ipsum Dei mediatorem et hominum; unde scriptum est
headnotes.en: …for you, which are your glory. For the sufferings are not worthy, etc. But the sun in the Scriptures has many meanings. Sometimes it signifies the very Mediator of God and of men; whence it is written

headnotes.la: id est Christus. Significat Ecclesiam sicut David dixit
headnotes.en: that is, Christ. It signifies the Church, as David said

headnotes.la: …ionis, sicut hic, et in Evangelio, ubi dicitur de semine quod cecidit supra petram, et orto sole exaestuavit. Quod ipse Dominus aperit exponens: Facta autem persecutione propter verbum, scandalizantur
headnotes.en: … of the seed that fell upon the rock, and when the sun was risen it was scorched. This the Lord himself opens up in explaining it: But when persecution arises for the word's sake, they are scandalized

headnotes.la: etc., *usque,*
headnotes.en: etc., *as far as,*

headnotes.la: Unde coeperit haec persecutio, ostendit cum subdit
headnotes.en: Whence this persecution began, he shows when he adds

headnotes.la: etc. Vox est primitivae Ecclesiae. Synagoga mater est, cui per Prophetam dicitur
headnotes.en: etc. This is the voice of the primitive Church. The Synagogue is the mother, to whom it is said through the Prophet

headnotes.la: Hujus filii sunt Judaei, qui pugnaverunt contra Ecclesiam primitivam, quando excitaverunt persecutionem contra credentes, et omnes dispersi sunt per regiones Samariae
headnotes.en: Her sons are the Jews, who fought against the primitive Church, when they stirred up persecution against the believers, and all were scattered throughout the regions of Samaria

headnotes.la: …m Ecclesia Hierosolymis, sed ob Judaicam persecutionem dispersis credentibus omnibus, multae vineae factae sunt, id est multae Ecclesiae constructae per universum mundum. Dicit ergo Ecclesia primitiva
headnotes.en: …, but through the Jewish persecution, when all the believers were scattered, many vineyards were made, that is, many churches were built throughout the whole world. The primitive Church therefore says

headnotes.la: id est ut essem custos ecclesiarum. Unde et in Graeco bene dicitur
headnotes.en: (namely the apostles and teachers)

headnotes.la: ubi nos legimus,
headnotes.en: that is, that I might be the keeper of the churches. Whence too in the Greek it is well said

headnotes.la: Ad hoc enim divinitus dispersi sunt, ut plures Ecclesiae fierent per universum mundum
headnotes.en: where we read,

headnotes.la: id est unam illam Ecclesiam quae in Hierosolymis fuit, non custodivi. Hoc non ad votum neque ad mentem est referendum, sed ad locum
headnotes.en: For to this end were they divinely scattered, that more churches might be made throughout the whole world
that is, that one Church which was at Jerusalem,

headnotes.la: …tum: O sponse, quem diligit anima mea, id est quem tota mentis intentione diligo, indica mihi ubi pascas, id est ubi oves tuas pascere facias; ipse est enim pastor bonus, sicut ipse dicit in Evangelio
headnotes.en: This is not to be referred to her will nor to her mind, but to place

headnotes.la: …fervore persecutionis vel tentationis. Laborans enim Ecclesia in persecutionibus, obsecrat sponsum suum ut ei dicat, in quorum mentibus requiescat. Nam cubare sponsi. requiescere est, sicut ipse dicit
etc. Ne enim sancti aestu tentationis arescant, ipse in eorum cordibus cubat et requiescit, atque ab omni fervore tentationum et persecutionum protegit. Quare hoc?
headnotes.en: …veth, that is, whom I love with the whole intention of my mind, show me where thou feedest, that is, where thou causest thy sheep to feed; for he is the good shepherd, as he himself says in the Gospel

…persecution or of temptation. For the Church, laboring in persecutions, entreats her bridegroom to tell her in whose minds he rests. For to lie down is, for the bridegroom, to rest, as he himself says

headnotes.la: …noscis, egredere de meo consortio, et abi post vestigia gregum; hoc est, sequere et imitare doctrinam errantium haereticorum, qui contempto vero pastore unius gregis, multos sibi coacervaverunt greges
headnotes.en: etc. For lest the saints wither in the heat of temptation, he himself lies down and rests in their hearts, and protects them from all the heat of temptations and persecutions. Why this?

headnotes.la: …st Christus, qui unum habet gregem, id est unitatem catholicae Ecclesiae. Pastores vero multi sunt haeretici, qui gregem deceptorum hominum sibi aggregant, quos diabolo pascunt: de quibus et Psalmista

headnotes.en: … and depart after the steps of the flocks; that is, follow and imitate the teaching of the erring heretics, who, despising the true shepherd of the one flock, have heaped up for themselves many flocks

headnotes.la: …etrare. Et est sensus: Noli timere ne vageris per greges sodalium meorum, quia tanto te amoris mei pudore, et tanta verecundia donavi, ut certus sim te me non posse deserere, vel ad alienos deflectere
Murenulae juxta litteram ornamentum sunt colli virginalis et puellaris, videlicet virgulae auri perplexae, intermixtis nonnunquam pulchra varietate subtilissimis argenti filis, et hoc est quod dicit,
headnotes.en: … through the flocks of my companions, because I have endowed thee with so great a modesty of my love, and so great a bashfulness, that I am certain thou canst not forsake me or turn aside to strangers

headnotes.la: … sponsae suae facit, cum Christus Ecclesiam suam doctrinis sanctorum Patrum sensu et eloquio fulgentibus instruit, atque ad illorum fidem et virtutem imitandam accendit. Notandum quod pluraliter dicit

headnotes.en: …ter, are an ornament of the neck of a virgin or a girl, namely little rods of gold intertwined, mixed here and there with a beautiful variety of the finest threads of silver, and this is what he says,

headnotes.la: …cubitus regis fuit incarnatio ejus. Accumbere enim est recubare vel rediscumbere. Et tunc Christus accubuit, quando pro nostra redemptione se usque ad suscipiendam naturam nostram inclinavit. Et tunc,
headnotes.en: …hen Christ instructs his Church with the teachings of the holy Fathers, shining with sense and eloquence, and kindles it to imitate their faith and virtue. It is to be noted that he says in the plural

headnotes.la: …ultura designantur: nam depositum corpus Domini de cruce a Nicodemo et Joseph, myrrha et aloe conditum est, et involutum linteis cum aromatibus, ac sepulturae traditum. Dicit ergo Ecclesia sponsa ejus
headnotes.en: … the king was his incarnation. For to recline is to lie back or to recline again. And Christ then reclined, when for our redemption he bowed himself down even to the taking on of our nature. And then,

headnotes.la: factus est, quia propter me mortuus est et sepultus est
Nemo dubitat locum cordis inter ubera esse. Dicit ergo
headnotes.en: …f the Lord, taken down from the cross by Nicodemus and Joseph, was embalmed with myrrh and aloes, and wrapped in linen cloths with spices, and given over to burial. The Church his bride therefore says
because for my sake he died and was buried

headnotes.la: …bi vites nobiles esse feruntur, maximos botros procreantes. Engaddi locus similiter esse fertur, habens arbusculas liquorem balsami desudantes. Loquitur ergo sponsa de resurrectione Christi sui sponsi
headnotes.en: No one doubts that the place of the heart is between the breasts. She says therefore

headnotes.la: Vox sponsi Christi ad sponsam suam Ecclesiam
headnotes.en: … to be, producing very large clusters. Engaddi likewise is said to be a place, having little trees exuding the liquor of balsam. The bride therefore speaks of the resurrection of Christ her bridegroom

headnotes.la: Bis eam repetit esse pulchram propter perfectionem operis et munditiam mentis
id est in bonis operibus perfecta es, sancte et pie et juste vivendo, secundum Apostolum
headnotes.en: It is the voice of the bridegroom Christ to his bride the Church

headnotes.la: mundum et simplicem cordis habens intentionem, quia non propter terrena commoda vel mundi gloriam, solummodo Ecclesiis Dei placens bona operaris
headnotes.en: He repeats twice that she is beautiful, on account of the perfection of her work and the purity of her mind
that is, thou art perfect in good works, living holily and piously and justly, according to the Apostle

headnotes.la: … et decorus, tu es fons totius boni, et quidquid boni habeo, tua gratia habeo Pulcher autem et decorus dicitur, quia et divinitatis perpetuitate, et etiam susceptae humanitatis dignitate mirabilis est
headnotes.en: having a pure and simple intention of heart, because thou workest good things not for the sake of earthly advantages or the glory of the world, but pleasing only the churches of God

headnotes.la: Postquam sponsa qualem domum ipsa et sponsus ejus habeant ostendit, ipse quoque sponsus de se qualis sit ostendit dicens

…iam tribuo, quae nullam in se spem habentes, mihi se humili devotione submittunt. Convalles significant mentes humiles, quarum lilium Christus est, quia pulchritudo humilium mentium ipse est qui dixit
Potest et hoc quod dicit,
headnotes.en: After the bride has shown what kind of house she and her bridegroom have, the bridegroom too shows what kind he himself is, saying

headnotes.la: ad incarnationem referri. Campus enim non aratur, non scinditur, non ullo vomere prosulcatur. Dicit ergo
headnotes.en: …those minds which, having no hope in themselves, submit themselves to me with humble devotion. The valleys signify humble minds, whose lily is Christ, because the beauty of humble minds is he who said

headnotes.la: id est filius virginis. Non ergo ruris, sed campi florem se vocat, quia virgineae carnis fructus est, secundum vaticinium Isaiae
headnotes.en: And this which he says,
can also be referred to the incarnation. For the field is not plowed, not cut, not furrowed by any plowshare. He says therefore

headnotes.la: Videns sponsam suam ad requiem festinare, et labores fugere, ac per quietem praesentis temporis ad aeternam beatitudinem tendere, se per pressuras et labores hujus saeculi illuc pervenire debere
headnotes.en: that is, the son of the Virgin. He calls himself, then, not the flower of the tilled ground, but of the field, because he is the fruit of virginal flesh, according to the prophecy of Isaiah

headnotes.la: Nunc sponsa laudata a sponso, vicem ei reddit, et dicit qualis quoque ipse sit
headnotes.en: … bride hasten to rest, and flee labors, and through the quiet of the present time tend toward eternal blessedness, whereas he himself must come thither through the afflictions and labors of this world

headnotes.la: …mo Christus Jesus speciali refulget gratia inter filios, id est inter electos. Ipse enim Dei Filius per naturam, reliqui electi per gratiam potestate ab unico Filio Dei ut sint filii Dei. Hinc Joannes
headnotes.en: he says,

headnotes.la: Non qualemcunque, sed quasi Unigeniti a Patre
quia in ejus protectione confido, et ab eo inter adversa gubernari spero. Umbra enim Christi protectio est divinitatis, quia electos tuetur et defendit
headnotes.en: Now the bride, praised by the bridegroom, returns to him his due, and says what kind he too is

headnotes.la: …fido: hoc est enim sanctorum exspectatio, hoc praemium et satietas, visio Conditoris sui. Desiderat ergo umbram Conditoris sui Ecclesia, quia protectionem illius exoptat inter praesentis vitae adversa
headnotes.en: …ns, that is, among the elect. For he himself is the Son of God by nature, while the rest of the elect are so by grace, having power from the only Son of God that they should be sons of God. Hence John
Not of any sort whatever, but as it were of the Only-begotten of the Father

headnotes.la: …otis viribus, omni mente. Proximus diligendus est denique sicut se unusquisque diligit. Nam confundere vult charitatem, quae proximi charitatem Dei dilectioni praeponit. De quibus Dominus in Evangelio
headnotes.en: because I trust in his protection, and hope to be governed by him amid adversities. For the shadow of Christ is the protection of his divinity, because it guards and defends the elect

headnotes.la: Vel etiam
headnotes.en: … saints, this their reward and satiety, the vision of their Maker. The Church, therefore, desires the shadow of her Maker, because she longs for his protection amid the adversities of the present life

headnotes.la: id est, ipse prior me dilexit, deinde qualiter eum diligere deberem docuit. Unde ipse dicit
Et Joannes dicit
headnotes.en: …ind. Then the neighbor is to be loved as each one loves himself. For he wishes to confound charity who sets the love of his neighbor before the love of God. Concerning whom the Lord says in the Gospel
Or also

headnotes.la: Postquam Ecclesia vel anima Deo dilecta in se charitatem ordinatam dixit, qualiter velit requiescere, vel in quo lecto cum dilecto sponso suo pausare, ostendit dicens
headnotes.en: that is, he himself first loved me, and then taught me how I ought to love him. Whence he himself says
And John says

headnotes.la: Vox sponsi adjurantis filias Hierusalem, id est amicas aeternis desideriis intentas, et visionem pacis requirentes, ne quiescentem suam animam suscitent et inquietent
headnotes.en: After the Church, or the soul beloved of God, has said that charity was set in order within her, she shows how she wishes to rest, or in what bed to repose with her beloved bridegroom, saying

headnotes.la: etc.; hoc est, animam divinae contemplationi deditam, orationibus vel lectionibus divinis occupatam, inquietare et ad exteriora opera suscitare ne velitis;
vox Ecclesiae
headnotes.en: …of the bridegroom adjuring the daughters of Jerusalem, that is, the friends intent on eternal desires, and seeking the vision of peace, that they stir not up nor disquiet his soul while she is at rest

headnotes.la: … a sponso, ut etiam filias Hierusalem pro illa adjuret, ut non eam requiescentem inquietent, dicit: Haec est vox dilecti mei pro me loquentis. Quem desiderans videre dilectum, sed non valens, annectit
headnotes.en: etc.; that is, be unwilling to disquiet the soul given over to divine contemplation, occupied with prayers or divine readings, and to rouse her to outward works;

headnotes.la: Montes et colles intelliguntur perfecti quique sanctae conversationis, sublimiter a terrenis sublevati, et quasi camporum planitiem melioris vitae meritis excedentes. De his montibus Isaias dicit
Loquitur ergo sponsa de dilecto suo
headnotes.en: the voice of the Church

headnotes.la: …osdam saltus dedit, quia de coelo venit in uterum Virginis, de utero Virginis in praesepe, de praesepi in baptismum, de baptismo in crucem, de cruce ad sepulcrum, de sepulcro ad coelum. Hinc Psalmista
headnotes.en: …jures the daughters of Jerusalem for her sake, that they disquiet her not while she rests, says: This is the voice of my beloved speaking for me. Desiring to see whom she loves, but not able, she adds

headnotes.la: …. Hinnulo autem cervorum similis dicitur, quia secundum humanitatem de cervis, hoc est, de patriarchis duxit originem; vel etiam propter varietatem virtutum et innocentiam, hinnulo cervorum comparatur

…frui. Namque primus homo ita conditus est, ut visione et alloquio Dei frueretur; sed postquam peccavit, appositus est quidam paries, ipsa videlicet mortalitas, qua praegravamur. Nam (ut Sapiens dicit)

…o paries oppositus erat inter nos et ipsum, nec videre illum poteramus, dignatus est in ipso pariete facere fenestras et cancellos, per quos utcunque sentiri utcunque perspici possit. Unde et sequitur
Quasi enim fenestrae et cancelli in pariete fiunt, cum ipse sua gratia se contemplari permittit, licet in speculo et aenigmate. Potest et hoc quod dicit,
headnotes.en: …, because according to his humanity he drew his origin from the harts, that is, from the patriarchs; or also, on account of the variety of his virtues and his innocence, he is compared to a young hart

headnotes.la: ad humanitatem ejus referri; quasi enim post parietem nostrum stetit, cum carnem nostram sibi apposuit, in qua divinitas ejus latuit. Quod vero sequitur
headnotes.en: …an was so made that he might enjoy the vision and converse of God; but after he sinned, a certain wall was set up, namely that very mortality with which we are weighed down. For (as the Wise Man says)

… up between us and him, and we could not see him, he deigned to make in that very wall windows and lattices, through which he might in some way be perceived, in some way be seen. Whence too it follows

headnotes.la: ad praedicandum hortatur me, dicens
headnotes.en: For windows and lattices are as it were made in the wall, when he permits himself to be contemplated by his grace, though in a glass and in a dark manner. And this which he says,

headnotes.la: Vox sponsi ad publicae operationis studia provocantis
headnotes.en: can also be referred to his humanity; for he stood as it were behind our wall, when he set our flesh before himself, in which his divinity lay hidden. But that which follows

headnotes.la: per fidem et dilectionem;
per innocentiam et simplicitatem;
headnotes.en: he exhorts me to preach, saying

headnotes.la: per virtutum pulchritudinem, festina
headnotes.en: It is the voice of the bridegroom calling to the zeal for public work

headnotes.la: Ac si diceret: Surge de strato tuo illo dulcissimo, hoc est de quiete, in qua soli mihi placere in psalmis, hymnis et orationibus desideras, festina
headnotes.en: through faith and love;
through innocence and simplicity;

headnotes.la: Hiemis et imbris nomine, asperitas infidelitatis exprimitur, quae totum mundum tenebat usque ad adventum Christi. Dicit ergo sponsus
headnotes.en: through the beauty of the virtues, hasten

headnotes.la: sole justitiae apparente, et imber infidelitatis recessit, ac serenitas verae fidei in mundum resplenduit. Tale est quod Apostolus ait
headnotes.en: As if he said: Arise from that most sweet couch of thine, that is, from the quiet in which thou desirest to please me alone in psalms, hymns, and prayers; hasten

headnotes.la: Finita hieme et imbre flores apparuerunt, decor videlicet virtutum et pudicitiae, et transeunte asperitate infidelitatis, verna fidei successit temperies
headnotes.en: By the name of winter and rain, the harshness of unbelief is expressed, which held the whole world until the coming of Christ. The bridegroom therefore says

headnotes.la: hoc est purgationis sanctorum. Putatio enim vinearum sanctorum significat purgationem, quae in Christo et per Christum est; de quo ipse
headnotes.en: the sun of justice appearing, and the rain of unbelief has gone, and the serenity of true faith has shone forth into the world. Such is what the Apostle says

headnotes.la: Hoc est vox praedicantium apostolorum. Turtur enim avis est; et quoniam in excelsis semper arboribus morari solet et nidificare, apostolos vel caeteros doctores significat, qui possunt dicere
headnotes.en: …inter and the rain being ended, the flowers have appeared, namely the comeliness of the virtues and of chastity, and, the harshness of unbelief passing away, the spring mildness of faith has succeeded

headnotes.la: Quod etiam gemitum pro cantu habet, sanctorum ploratum significat, qui suos ad fletum et lamenta hortantur, dicentes
headnotes.en: that is, of the purging of the saints. For the pruning of the vineyards of the saints signifies the purging which is in Christ and through Christ; concerning whom he himself says

headnotes.la: vel,
Vox turturis audita est in terra nostra; id est vox praedicantium apostolorum, in terra nostra, hoc est in Ecclesia. De qua Psalmista
headnotes.en: This is the voice of the preaching apostles. For the turtledove is a bird; and since it is always wont to tarry and nest in lofty trees, it signifies the apostles or the other teachers, who can say
And because it has a groaning for its song, it signifies the weeping of the saints, who exhort their own to weeping and lamentation, saying

headnotes.la: …ngelii, volentes circumcisionem, sabbatum et alia legis praecepta juxta litteram observare. De quibus Apostolus dicit: Aemulantur vos non bene, sed volunt vos circumcidi, ut in carne vestra glorientur
headnotes.en: or,

headnotes.la: …stquam ficus protulit grossos suos, vineae florentes dederunt odorem; quia multitudo Ecclesiarum per latitudinem orbis diffusa est, quae flores virtutum et odorem bonae opinionis late de se spargerent
headnotes.en: The voice of the turtle is heard in our land; that is, the voice of the preaching apostles, in our land, that is, in the Church. Concerning which the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: Si petra est Christus, juxta quod Apostolus ait,
headnotes.en: … the law according to the letter. Concerning whom the Apostle says: They are zealous for you not well, but they would exclude you, that you might be zealous for them; that they may glory in your flesh

headnotes.la: …uia totam spem salutis suae in passione sui Redemptoris constituit. Ibi ab insidiis malignorum spirituum quasi a raptu accipitris secura delitescit; ibi nidificat, id est fetus bonorum operum congerit
headnotes.en: …odor; because the multitude of churches was diffused throughout the breadth of the world, which should spread abroad far and wide from themselves the flowers of the virtues and the odor of good repute

headnotes.la: …nearum solent fieri, ad repellendas vulpes vel caeteras nocivas bestiolas. Per maceriam ergo significatur coelestium custodia virtutum, angelicum videlicet praesidium, sicut Isaias de Domini vinea ait
In caverna ergo maceriae moratur, quia praesidio angelorum undique circumdatur, et a tentationibus diaboli custoditur
headnotes.en: If the rock is Christ, according to what the Apostle says,

headnotes.la: …lecto contemplationis dulcissime quiescis, veni et ostende mihi faciem tuam; id est a secreto quietis egredere ad publicam actionem, et pulchritudinem bonorum operum tuorum aliis ad exemplum demonstra
headnotes.en: …n in the passion of her Redeemer. There, safe from the snares of the malignant spirits as from the seizure of a hawk, she lies hidden; there she nests, that is, she gathers the offspring of good works

headnotes.la: …uasi enim Deo faciem suam ostendit Ecclesia, cum proximis ad utilitatem et profectum per virtutum opera, quantam intrinsecus habeat pulchritudinem, demonstrat. Hoc est quod Dominus dicit in Evangelio,
headnotes.en: …, to drive off foxes or other harmful little beasts. By the wall, therefore, is signified the guardianship of the heavenly virtues, namely the angelic protection, as Isaiah says of the Lord's vineyard
In the hollow of the wall, therefore, she tarries, because she is on every side surrounded by the protection of the angels, and guarded from the temptations of the devil

headnotes.la: …ox videlicet praedicationis vel divinae laudis, qua alios facias proficere. In auribus enim Domini vox Ecclesiae sonat, cum per praedicationem ex multorum conversione delectatur Deus. Bene autem dicit
headnotes.en: …t most sweetly in the bed of contemplation, come and show me thy face; that is, go forth from the secret of quiet to public action, and show forth the beauty of thy good works to others for an example

headnotes.la: et vox tua non aliena; tuam videlicet faciem mihi ostende, quam in baptismo tibi dedi, quando mundavi te ab omni peccato
headnotes.en: …were her face to God, when to her neighbors, for their profit and advancement, she demonstrates by the works of the virtues how great a beauty she has within. This is what the Lord says in the Gospel,

headnotes.la: Vox sponsi praecipientis sponsae suae et filiabus Hierusalem, sanctis videlicet doctoribus vel animabus fidelibus
headnotes.en: …vine praise, by which thou mayest make others to profit. For the voice of the Church sounds in the ears of the Lord, when through preaching God is delighted by the conversion of many. And well he says

headnotes.la: …lium, lacerare et decipere non cessant. Praecipit ergo ut parvulas vulpes capiant, id est, ut haereticam pravitatem in ipso initio debellare et destruere non cessent, ne robusta facta fortius impugnet
headnotes.en: and thy voice, not another's; namely, show me thy face, which I gave thee in baptism, when I cleansed thee from all sin

headnotes.la: id est Ecclesia per universum mundum flores virtutum emisit. Et nota quia cum superius vineas pluraliter dixerit, modo dicit singulariter,
headnotes.en: he says,

headnotes.la: Vox sponsae,
subaudis societur vinculo charitatis et amoris, et ego illi conjungar et consocier vicissitudine mutuae difectionis. Et
subaudis det verba exhortationis et divinae promissionis,

… conjungar vinculo dignae obedientiae, obtemperans praeceptis ejus qui pascitur inter lilia, hoc est delectatur et jucundatur inter candidas et odoriferas virtutes sanctorum. Et notandum quod superius
singulariter dicitur, hic vero pluraliter
headnotes.en: The voice of the bride,

headnotes.la: quia multae sunt virtutes sanctorum, una tamen fides est, et una charitas, quibus praecipue Deus delectatur. Sive etiam,
headnotes.en: supply: let him be joined by the bond of charity and love, and I to him let me be conjoined and associated by the alternation of mutual love. And

headnotes.la: hoc est suavissime delectatur inter virgineos choros. Candor enim liliorum recte munditiae virginali comparatur
headnotes.en: supply: let him give the words of exhortation and of divine promise,

… of worthy obedience, obeying the precepts of him who feedeth among the lilies, that is, is delighted and gladdened among the white and fragrant virtues of the saints. And it is to be noted that above

headnotes.la: …atem divinitatis tuae me speculari permitte, et hoc quod mihi perfecte promittis in alia vita, beatitudinem videlicet tuam, in hac adhuc peregrinatione me saltem in figura et aenigmate habere permitte
headnotes.en: is said in the singular, but here in the plural

headnotes.la: …consurgens, vel domus vigiliarum, vigiles mentes sanctorum significat, quae ad desideranda superna consurgunt, et ad ea percipienda invigilant. habentes in se Deum habitatorem, qui dicit per Prophetam
headnotes.en: because many are the virtues of the saints, yet there is one faith, and one charity, with which God is especially delighted. Or also,

headnotes.la: … Creatorem cognoscere volentes; sicut Plato, qui in Timaeo multa de anima disputavit, et sicut Aristoteles, Socrates et caeteri, qui omne vitae suae tempus in studiis exquirendae veritatis expendebant
Exsurgam inde de strato corporis et carnalis delectationis, et circuibo civitatem hujus mundi, maria ac terras peragrando

…uoque in Cornelio adimpletum est, qui adhuc paganus et ignorans Deum, eleemosynas faciebat, et orationibus vacabat, quem Petrus cum domo sua baptizavit. Et erat adhuc difficultas inventionis, et dicit

headnotes.en: …h the creature; as Plato, who in the Timaeus disputed much concerning the soul, and as Aristotle, Socrates, and the rest, who spent all the time of their life in the studies of searching out the truth

headnotes.la: Vigiles sunt sancti et caeteri doctores Ecclesiae, qui civitatem, id est sanctam Ecclesiam, custodiunt, et ab insidiis infidelium hostium defendunt. Quos interrogat,

headnotes.en: I will rise up from there, from the couch of the body and of carnal delight, and I will go about the city of this world, traversing seas and lands

headnotes.la: …ima mea, hoc est, cum intellexissem Christum omnem sublimitatem et gratiam superare, tunc inveni quem diligit anima mea, hoc est, tunc vere intellexi quantum ipse a caeterorum sanctorum meritis distet
headnotes.en: …ulfilled in Cornelius, who, still a pagan and ignorant of God, gave alms, and was constant in prayers, whom Peter baptized with his household. And there was still a difficulty of finding, and she says

headnotes.la: hoc est, ardentissima fide et devotione illi inhaesi
sed in ejus amore et fide perseverabo,
headnotes.en: The watchmen are the holy ones and the other teachers of the Church, who keep the city, that is, the holy Church, and defend it from the snares of the unfaithful enemies. Whom she asks,

headnotes.la: hoc est, donec illum Synagogae, quae est mater mea spiritualiter, praedicem, et eam quoque ad ejus fidem perducam. Hoc fiet in die judicii, quando (ut ait Apostolus)
Tantum ergo sibi de charitate sponsi sui Ecclesia promittit, ut etiam se credat Synagogam posse convertere. Quod autem dicit,
headnotes.en: … when I had understood that Christ surpasses all loftiness and grace, then I found him whom my soul loveth, that is, then I truly understood how far he stands apart from the merits of the other saints

headnotes.la: … tunc relictura sit illum, cum in cubiculum matris introduxerit, sed *Donec* pro sempiterno ponitur, id est semper illi inhaerebo, semper in ejus fide et dilectione perseverabo Tale est in psalmo: Ita
headnotes.en: that is, with a most ardent faith and devotion I cleaved to him
but I will persevere in his love and faith,

headnotes.la: …, ita is qui divinae contemplationi insistit, quasi alienus est et dormit exterioribus, sola spiritualia et coelestitia videt. Nec mirum si amor somnus vocatur, cum in sequentibus mors amor appelletur
headnotes.en: that is, till I preach him to the Synagogue, which is spiritually my mother, and lead her too to his faith. This shall come to pass in the day of judgment, when (as the Apostle says)

headnotes.la: Cum autem dicit
headnotes.en: So greatly, therefore, does the Church promise herself concerning the charity of her bridegroom, that she believes she can even convert the Synagogue. But that which she says,

…ght him into the chamber of her mother, but *Till* is put for the everlasting, that is, I will always cleave to him, I will always persevere in his faith and love. Such is the passage in the psalm: So

headnotes.la: Vox filiarum Hierusalem, id est sanctorum primitivae Ecclesiae admirantium pulchritudinem Ecclesiae de gentibus congregatae
Quae, id est qualis. Quanta laude et admiratione digna, quae non circumcisione mundata, nec adhuc baptismo sanctificata, jam currit ad Deum?
headnotes.en: …mplation is as it were a stranger, and sleeps to outward things, and sees only the spiritual and heavenly things. Nor is it a wonder if love is called sleep, since in what follows love is called death

headnotes.la: …rtum nationum ascendebat, jam de Aegypto (hoc est, de confusione idololatriae) liberata, et Pharaone, id est diabolo submerso, ut coelesti manna pasceretur, et veram terram repromissionis ingrederetur
headnotes.en: But when he says

headnotes.la: ad montes virtutum, vel etiam ad ipsum virtutibus sublevata, qui in psalmo dicit
etc., et alibi
headnotes.en: The voice of the daughters of Jerusalem, that is, of the saints of the primitive Church, marveling at the beauty of the Church gathered from the Gentiles

headnotes.la: …anima fidelis, quia illorum doctrinam actusque considerat, illorum exemplo et intercessione muniri gaudet. Postea proficiens, ad ipsum quoque qui fecit montes, audet cordis aspectum dirigere, et dicit
headnotes.en: Who, that is, of what sort. Of how great praise and admiration worthy, who, not cleansed by circumcision, nor yet sanctified by baptism, already runs to God?

headnotes.la: id est gratanter requiescis in sanctis
headnotes.en: …ions, now freed from Egypt (that is, from the confusion of idolatry), and, Pharaoh, that is, the devil, being drowned, that she might be fed with the heavenly manna, and enter the true land of promise

headnotes.la: …, non habens grossitudinem carnalium desideriorum. Sive virgulae fumi non sparso fumo comparantur, propter unitatem Ecclesiae, quae in Christo unum est. Unde vero esset ille fumus, ostendit cum subdit
headnotes.en: to the mountains of the virtues, or also to him himself, raised up by the virtues, who says in the psalm

headnotes.la: … munditia orationum exprimitur. Virgulae ergo fumi, myrrhae et thuris Ecclesia assimilatur, quia sancti mortificatione carnis suae, et orationibus mundo ac simplici corde perfusis, Deo placere student
headnotes.en: etc., and elsewhere

headnotes.la: Quo haec dilecta ascenderit, ostenditur cum subditur

…um suis sanctis requiescit, probabilius tamen praesens accipitur, in qua sancti Dei sopitis tumultibus vitiorum, amplexu Salomonis, id est veri pacifici delectantur. Unde et Psalmista de Christo dicit

…od in fine electis dabitur. Unde et hi qui in vineam venerunt, denarium leguntur accepisse. Sexaginta ergo fortes significant (ut dictum est) sanctos doctores, fortes et animo constantes. Additur vero

…raedicando, et ab incursibus daemonum vel impugnatione haereticorum defendere noverunt. Hi ergo ambiunt lectulum Salomonis, quia illis commissa est Ecclesia, et ab illis vigilanti cura est custodienda
tenent enim gladium spiritualem verbi Dei, de quo Apostolus
headnotes.en: Whither this beloved had gone up is shown when it is added

headnotes.la: …ia nequitiae in coelestibus bella gerunt. Versutissimus enim ille est hostis, et tanta subtilitate spiritualis naturae, qui etiam temporis longaevitate doctissimus, contra quem sancti bella suscipiunt
headnotes.en: … rest, in which the saints of God, the tumults of the vices being lulled to sleep, are delighted with the embrace of Solomon, that is, of the true Peaceable One. Whence too the Psalmist says of Christ

headnotes.la: Per femur propagatio sobolis accipitur. Super femur ergo enses habent, quia timore Dei omnes comprimuntur, et coercent motus carnalis voluptatis. Et hoc
headnotes.en: … those who came into the vineyard are read to have received a penny. The threescore valiant ones, therefore, signify (as has been said) the holy teachers, valiant and constant in mind. And it is added

…from the assaults of demons or the attack of heretics. These, therefore, surround the little bed of Solomon, because to them the Church is committed, and by them it is to be guarded with watchful care
for they hold the spiritual sword of the word of God, of which the Apostle says

headnotes.la: Per columnas doctores ejusdem Ecclesiae significantur, qui eam verbo et exemplo sustinent ac roborant. Unde in Actibus apostolorum
headnotes.en: …wickedness in the high places. For that enemy is most cunning, and of so great subtlety of spiritual nature, being also by the long span of time most expert, against whom the saints take up their wars

headnotes.la: Hae columnae sunt argenteae, quia nitore coelestis eloquii refulgent
headnotes.en: …thigh is received the propagation of offspring. Upon the thigh, therefore, they have their swords, because by the fear of God all are restrained, and they curb the motions of carnal pleasure. And this

headnotes.la: etc

… purpureo ad reclinatorium pervenitur, quia illi ad aeternarum epularum discubitum et ad supernae quietis requiem veniunt, qui in praesenti passionem Redemptoris sui digne venerari et imitari satagunt

…em Christi imitati, pro illo suum sanguinem fuderunt. Sed quid nos faciemus, dicit beatus Gregorius, qui nullius meriti sumus? Non inter doctores, non inter martyres locum nos habere videmur. Sequitur
headnotes.en: By the pillars are signified the teachers of that same Church, who sustain and strengthen it by word and example. Whence in the Acts of the Apostles
These pillars are of silver, because they shine with the brightness of heavenly eloquence

headnotes.la: … filiae Sion, hoc est exite de turbulenta hujus saeculi conversatione, ut mente expedita eum quem diligitis contemplari possitis. Et videte (inquit) regem Salomonem, hoc est, verum pacificum Christum,
headnotes.en: etc

headnotes.la: …spem contulit. De hoc diademate Apostolus ait: Vidimus Jesum per passionem gloria et honore coronatum. Mater vero sua eum coronasse dicitur, quia virgo Maria illi de sua carne carnis materiem praebuit
headnotes.en: …s to the seat, because they come to the reclining at the eternal banquets and to the rest of the heavenly quiet who in the present strive worthily to venerate and imitate the passion of their Redeemer

headnotes.la: hoc est, in tempore incarnationis, quando sibi Ecclesiam conjunxit non habentem maculam aut rugam, vel quando Deus homini conjunctus est
headnotes.en: …hrist, poured out their blood for him. But what shall we do, says the blessed Gregory, who are of no merit? Neither among the teachers, nor among the martyrs, do we seem to have a place. There follows

headnotes.la: Laetitia enim et gaudium Christi, salus et redemptio humani generis est, juxta quod in Evangelio multos ad fidem suam cernens confluere, in illa (inquit evangelista) hora exsultavit, et dixit
Et in Evangelica parabola inventa ove, convocavit amicos, dicens
headnotes.en: …t from the turbulent conversation of this world, that with mind unencumbered you may be able to contemplate him whom you love. And see (she says) king Solomon, that is, the true Peaceable One, Christ,

headnotes.la: Potest hoc et simpliciter totum ad passionem Christi referri juxta litteram. Praevidens etiam Salomon in spiritu passionem Christi, longe ante praemonebat filiam Sion, id est plebem Israeliticam,
headnotes.en: …We see Jesus, for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honor. And his mother is said to have crowned him, because the Virgin Mary furnished him, from her own flesh, the material of his flesh

headnotes.la: inquiens,
headnotes.en: that is, in the time of the incarnation, when he joined the Church to himself, not having spot or wrinkle, or when God was joined to man

headnotes.la: id est Christum,
headnotes.en: … gladness of Christ is the salvation and redemption of the human race, according to what in the Gospel, seeing many flow together to his faith, in that (says the evangelist) hour he rejoiced, and said

headnotes.la: id est in spinea corona,
headnotes.en: And in the Gospel parable, the sheep being found, he called together his friends, saying

headnotes.la: Synagoga,
headnotes.en: …d wholly to the passion of Christ according to the letter. Solomon also, foreseeing in spirit the passion of Christ, long before forewarned the daughter of Zion, that is, the Israelite people, saying,

headnotes.la: quando videlicet sibi conjunxit Ecclesiam;
headnotes.en: that is, Christ,

headnotes.la: Vox Christi. Bis repetit,

… et praedicatione. In opere, quia nihil foedum, nihil oculis meis indignum agis; in praedicatione, quia ad considerandum incarnationis meae mysterium, etiam sodales tuas Hierusalem invitare non cessas

…uum spiritualium, quibus divina et sempiterna contemplatur Ecclesia. Columbae autem oculi Ecclesiae comparantur propter spiritualem gratiam, quia Spiritus sanctus in specie columbae apparuit. Sequitur

…e illius retributionis gloria quam in fine saeculi es perceptura, quam etsi in praesenti per fidem contempleris, latet tamen intrinsecus: nec enim in praesenti videri potest, sed in futuro perficietur
headnotes.en: The voice of Christ. He repeats twice,

headnotes.la: …cclesiae. Et bene gregibus comparantur caprarum. Capra peccatoribus convenit, per quod plebes fidelium actionibus saeculi deditae, quae sine peccato agi non possunt, intelliguntur. Bene autem sequitur
headnotes.en: …hing. In work, because thou doest nothing foul, nothing unworthy of my eyes; in preaching, because thou ceasest not to invite even thy companions of Jerusalem to consider the mystery of my incarnation

headnotes.la: …mutui foederis acervum lapidum erexerunt. Mystice, acervus testimonii Christus est, in quo multitudo consistit omnium sanctorum, qui sunt lapides vivi, adhaerentes illi vero lapidi de quo Petrus dicit
headnotes.en: …h contemplates the divine and everlasting things. But the eyes of the Church are compared to a dove on account of spiritual grace, because the Holy Spirit appeared in the form of a dove. There follows

…to receive at the end of the world, which, although in the present thou contemplate it through faith, yet lies hidden within: for it cannot be seen in the present, but shall be perfected in the future

headnotes.la: …ancti doctores bene dentibus conformantur, quia spirituales cibos, quos simplices capere nequeunt, ipsi quodammodo exponendo comminuunt. Deus Ecclesiae praecipue erat Petrus, cui dictum est in visione
headnotes.en: …y compared to flocks of goats. The goat suits sinners, by which are understood the peoples of the faithful given over to the actions of the world, which cannot be done without sin. Well does it follow

headnotes.la: …m sunt sancti doctores et magistri Ecclesiae, qui et lavacro baptismi abluti sunt; et vellera, id est facultates et substantias suas pro Christo amiserunt. Omnibus quidem fidelibus convenit quod dicit
headnotes.en: …venant they raised a heap of stones. Mystically, the heap of testimony is Christ, in whom stands the multitude of all the saints, who are living stones, adhering to that true stone of which Peter says

headnotes.la: … sequuntur Christum. Tales ergo sunt dentes Ecclesiae sanctae, id est praedicatores et magistri ejus, oves per innocentiam abluti baptismo, voluntaria paupertate et rerum sponsione gaudentes. Sequitur

headnotes.en: …teeth, because the spiritual foods which the simple cannot grasp, they in a certain manner break up small by expounding. Peter especially was the teeth of the Church, to whom it was said in the vision

headnotes.la: …unum decorem redigunt. Possunt etiam per capillos subtiles cogitationes mentis accipi. Vitta ergo coccinea crines ligamus, quando cogitationes nostras disciplina timoris Dei constringimus et coercemus
headnotes.en: …ters of the Church, who are both washed in the washing of baptism; and have lost their fleeces, that is, their faculties and substances, for Christ. To all the faithful indeed suits that which he says

headnotes.la: …lce est eloquium Ecclesiae, cum sancti doctores vel passionem sui Redemptoris ad memoriam reducunt, et praedicant quantum Deus hominem dilexerit, vel etiam cum coelestia praemia auditoribus annuntiant
headnotes.en: …fore, are the teeth of the holy Church, that is, its preachers and masters, sheep washed in baptism through innocence, rejoicing in voluntary poverty and in the surrender of their goods. There follows

headnotes.la: …s. Genae ergo Ecclesiae fragmini mali Punici comparantur, quia sancti doctores venerabiliter agunt memoriam passionis Redemptoris sui, nec erubescunt crucem ejus, imo gloriantur, dicentes cum Apostolo
et alibi Apostolus ad discipulum suum scribens
headnotes.en: …s. By the hair can also be received the subtle thoughts of the mind. With a scarlet fillet, therefore, we bind the hairs, when we constrain and curb our thoughts with the discipline of the fear of God

…eech of the Church, when the holy teachers either recall to memory the passion of their Redeemer, and preach how greatly God loved man, or also when they announce the heavenly rewards to their hearers

headnotes.la: …nu fortis vel visu desiderabilis, Christum significat. Et tota quidem Ecclesia, civitas David, id est magni regis Christi est, qui est manu fortis, quoniam diabolum devicit, juxta quod Psalmista dicit
headnotes.en: …compared to a piece of a pomegranate, because the holy teachers reverently keep the memory of the passion of their Redeemer, nor are they ashamed of his cross, nay, they glory, saying with the Apostle

headnotes.la: Est et visu desiderabilis, quia (ut Apostolus dicit) in eum desiderant angeli prospicere. Turris autem civitatis hujus illi sunt qui vel scientia vel operationis perfectione caeteris praeeminent
headnotes.en: and elsewhere the Apostle, writing to his disciple

headnotes.la: Propugnacula sunt sanctarum Scripturarum divinarum sacramenta, de quibus veluti jacula procedunt, quibus adversariae repelluntur potestates
Mille clypei intelliguntur innumera defensionis divinae praesidia, quibus sancta vallatur et defenditur Ecclesia
headnotes.en: …arance," signifies Christ. And the whole Church indeed is the city of David, that is, of the great king Christ, who is strong of hand, since he conquered the devil, according to what the Psalmist says

…in appearance, because (as the Apostle says) the angels desire to look upon him. But the tower of this city are those who are preeminent above the rest either in knowledge or in the perfection of work

headnotes.la: …, hoc est Christum et Ecclesiam, conjungunt. Ipsi ergo doctores sunt et ubera Ecclesiae, quia parvulos et simplices fideles lacte verbi Dei nutriunt, juxta quod Apostolus simplicioribus loquens, dicit
headnotes.en: The bulwarks are the divine mysteries of the holy Scriptures, from which, as it were darts, proceed the shafts by which the adversary powers are driven back

headnotes.la: Et bene non absolute ubera, sed cum additamento dicit,
headnotes.en: By the thousand bucklers are understood the innumerable defenses of the divine protection, with which the holy Church is walled about and defended

headnotes.la: cum femina neque plus neque minus habeat quam duo ubera, quia nimirum sancti doctores parvulos ex utroque populo, Judaico videlicet et gentili, lacte verbi Dei nutriunt. Nam et Paulus de seipso dicit

…haec enim animalia et acutissime vident, et nimia velocitate altiora conscendunt. Sic et Christi doctores quae agenda sunt et ipsi vident, et aliis monstrant, et despectis terrenis ad superna nituntur
headnotes.en: …ore, are also the breasts of the Church, because they nourish the little ones and the simple faithful with the milk of the word of God, according to what the Apostle, speaking to the more simple, says

headnotes.la: hoc est, dies illa aeterna veniat, quam desiderabat Psalmista, dicens
hoc est, transeant moerores et perturbationes hujus saeculi

…ia omnes, revelata facie, gloriam Domini contemplabuntur. Unde et Dominus per Prophetam dicit: Non docebit vir fratrem suum dicens, Cognosce Dominum; omnes enim cognoscent me a minimo usque ad maximum
headnotes.en: that is, till that eternal day come which the Psalmist desired, saying

headnotes.la: Vox sponsi ad amicam suam sponsam

…culos Dei, qui summa scientia et contemplatione praeeminent, sed etiam simplices quique fideles, qui recta fide et bonis operibus exornantur, pulchri in oculis sponsi habentur. Nam ut Psalmista dicit,
headnotes.en: that is, till the sorrows and perturbations of this world pass away

headnotes.la: ideo dicit
headnotes.en: …all contemplate the glory of the Lord. Whence too the Lord says through the Prophet: A man shall not teach his brother, saying, Know the Lord; for all shall know me from the least even to the greatest

headnotes.la: non pars tua. Hoc ideo dicimus, non quod aliquis in praesenti vita sine peccato esse possit, cum scriptum sit

headnotes.en: The voice of the bridegroom to his love the bride

headnotes.la: Libanus mons est Phoenicis. Interpretatur autem ex Hebraeo dealbatio vel candidatio, ex Graeco autem thus interpretatur. Unde et supra, ubi loquitur
headnotes.en: …nt in the highest knowledge and contemplation, but also all the simple faithful, who are adorned with right faith and good works, are held fair in the eyes of the bridegroom. For as the Psalmist says,

headnotes.la: …am ad coelestia praemia ducit, sed etiam per internam inspirationem ut in virtutibus proficiat hortatur. Quot enim in virtutibus sancti proficiunt, quasi tot passibus ad Deum tendunt, et tertio dicit,
headnotes.en: therefore he says

headnotes.la: …vocat secundo, ut dignam coelestium praemiorum retributionem jam liberata a corpore accipiat; vocat tertio, ut in die generalis resurrectionis jam sumpto corpore, duplici stola perpetuo ornata gaudeat
headnotes.en: not a part of thee. This we say not because anyone in the present life can be without sin, since it is written

headnotes.la: …ndit, eamque emundatam sordibus peccatorum, dote Spiritus sancti sibi conjunxit. Soror vero est, quia propter eam incarnatus, frater ejus fieri dignatus est, sicut resurgens a mortuis dixit mulieribus
headnotes.en: Lebanon is a mountain of Phoenicia. Now from the Hebrew it is interpreted as a whitening or a making-white, but from the Greek it is interpreted as frankincense. Whence also above, where he speaks

headnotes.la: Cum ergo dicit vulneratum se cor habere, magnitudinem amoris expressit, quo sanctam suam diligit Ecclesiam. Affirmat autem hoc iterans et inculcans,
headnotes.en: …rds, but he also exhorts it by inward inspiration to advance in the virtues. For as many steps as the saints advance in the virtues, by so many steps, as it were, they press on toward God; and he says

headnotes.la: ut tali iteratione quantum Ecclesiam suam diligit, ostendat. Qua autem re vulneratum sit, subjungendo demonstrat
headnotes.en: …e a worthy recompense of the heavenly rewards; he calls her a third time, that on the day of the general resurrection, the body now taken up again, she may rejoice, adorned forever with a twofold robe

headnotes.la: …pluraliter dixit oculos et capillos, hic singulariter dicit in uno oculo et in uno crine, ut per hoc unitas sanctorum doctorum exprimatur. Unitas est enim coelestis doctrinae, quam subjectis impendunt
necnon et una devotio subjectorum fidelium. Potest et hoc quod dicit,
headnotes.en: …ins, joined her to himself with the dowry of the Holy Spirit; and she is sister, because, being incarnate for her sake, he deigned to become her brother, as, rising from the dead, he said to the women

headnotes.la: Vulnerasti cor meum, id est tuo amore fecisti ut ego in cruce vulnerarer. Notandum vero quod dicit,
headnotes.en: When therefore he says that he has his heart wounded, he expressed the greatness of the love with which he loves his holy Church. And he affirms this by repeating and pressing it,
that by such repetition he may show how greatly he loves his Church. But by what thing it has been wounded he shows by adding

headnotes.la: …em doctores diximus figurari, qui et per oculos designantur; nam sancti doctores mammae sunt, id est simplici doctrina humiles nutriunt; oculi sunt, cum summa quaeque et coelestia praedicant. Ait ergo
headnotes.en: … here he says in the singular in one eye and in one hair, that by this the unity of the holy teachers may be expressed. For the unity of heavenly doctrine is that which they bestow upon their subjects

headnotes.la: …oelestia praedicant. Ait ergo: « Quam pulchrae sunt mammae tuae, soror mea sponsa; id est, quam pulchri sunt doctores tui, quoniam sermo illorum et eloquio praeeminet, et pondere sensuum pretiosus est
headnotes.en: and likewise one devotion of the subject faithful. This too which he says,

headnotes.la: Hic versiculus jam superius expositus est, ubi dicitur
headnotes.en: can be taken of the passion of Christ

headnotes.la: Et hoc notandum quod Ecclesia superius ubera sponsi sui laudavit dicens
headnotes.en: that is, by thy love thou hast brought it about that I should be wounded on the cross. But it is to be noted that he says,

headnotes.la: …sponsae suae ubera extollit, ut per hoc unitas Christi et Ecclesiae commendetur. Christus enim caput est, et Ecclesia corpus ejus: praecellit enim initium praedicationis evangelicae legalem sententiam

…avus distillans vocatur, quia multipliciter intelligitur et variis sensibus exponitur, nunc juxta litteram, nunc juxta allegoriam, nunc juxta moralitatem, nunc juxta anagogen, id est superiorem sensum

…alem doctrinam significat, quae perfectis et instructis convenit. Sub lingua ergo Ecclesiae mel et lac est, quia aliquando coelestia mysteria perfectis, aliquando rudibus plana et simplicia annuntiant
Vestimenta Ecclesiae sunt bonorum operum ornamenta, juxta quod Joannes in Apocalypsi dicit
Et in Job dicitur

…gnari. Vestimenta ergo Ecclesiae thuri comparantur, quia omnia opera Ecclesiae quasi orationes sunt. In cunctis enim quae agit semper Dominum deprecatur, et tali modo impletur illud quod Dominus dicit

headnotes.en: …t is understood in manifold ways and expounded in various senses, now according to the letter, now according to allegory, now according to morality, now according to anagogy, that is, the higher sense

… and the instructed. Under the tongue of the Church, then, are honey and milk, because sometimes they announce the heavenly mysteries to the perfect, sometimes plain and simple things to the untrained

headnotes.la: …mper in memoria retinent. Et sicut malum Punicum intra unum corticem multitudinem continet granorum, ita in Ecclesia multitudo fidelium intra fidem Dominicae passionis continetur. Hinc Apostolus dicit
headnotes.en: The garments of the Church are the ornaments of good works, according to what John says in the Apocalypse
And in Job it is said

headnotes.la: …t. Nardus ergo in horto Ecclesiae est, cum sancti quique memoriam Dominicae passionis venerantur, eique gratias agunt, quod intantum eos dilexerit, ut pro eorum salute et liberatione mortem susciperet
headnotes.en: …re compared to frankincense, because all the works of the Church are as it were prayers. For in all that she does she always entreats the Lord, and in such manner is fulfilled that which the Lord says

headnotes.la: Crocus aurosi coloris habet florem, ideoque significat charitatem. Sicut enim aurum inter omnia metalla pretiosius est, ita charitas inter omnes virtutes primatum tenet, dicente Apostolo

…bet corticem, cinnamomum vero cinereum habet colorem, significat quia sancti Dei quanto plus memores passionis Redemptoris sui, tanto in oculis suis viliores et despectiores sunt, dicentes cum Abraham
et cum Job
headnotes.en: …r. And just as the pomegranate contains within one bark a multitude of seeds, so in the Church the multitude of the faithful is contained within the faith of the Lord's passion. Hence the Apostle says

headnotes.la: … ergo et cinnamomo universa ligna Libani in horto Ecclesiae memorantur, quia sive humiles et patientes, sive perfecti quique doctores eamdem fidem habent in Ecclesia, et eamdem beatitudinem exspectant
headnotes.en: …n the garden of the Church, when all the saints venerate the memory of the Lord's passion, and give him thanks that he so loved them that he took upon himself death for their salvation and deliverance

headnotes.la: …se dicitur mixturam myrrhae et aloes quasi libras centum. Per has ergo arbores designatur carnis continentia et castimonia. Nam putredo luxuriam solet designare, juxta quod Propheta de quibusdam dicit
headnotes.en: Saffron has a flower of golden color, and therefore signifies charity. For as gold is more precious among all metals, so charity holds the primacy among all the virtues, the Apostle saying

headnotes.la: In horto ergo Ecclesiae sunt myrrhae et aloe, hoc est, mentes coelestes et omnis corruptionis immunes, audientes ab Apostolo
headnotes.en: …lly to hold the love of God and of neighbor. Now saffron is said to cool fiery fevers; so true charity cools the ardor of worldly concupiscence, and kindles in the mind the love of God and of neighbor

…innamon has an ashen color, signifies that the saints of God, the more they are mindful of the passion of their Redeemer, the more base and contemptible they are in their own eyes, saying with Abraham

headnotes.la: Prima unguenta quid melius quam charitas intelliguntur? de qua Apostolus dicit
headnotes.en: and with Job

headnotes.la: ac deinde

headnotes.en: …on are eminent in beauty and height and strength, and therefore signify the teachers and all the perfect in the Church, of whom above the house of the Church is read to be made, the same Church saying

headnotes.la: …iventes ipsa mysteria designantur Scripturarum, quia in se coelestem habent virtutem. At contra cisternae vocantur, id est collectiones aquarum, documenta haereticorum, de quibus Dominus per Prophetam
headnotes.en: …all the trees of Lebanon are mentioned in the garden of the Church, because whether the humble and patient, or all the perfect teachers, have the same faith in the Church, and await the same beatitude

headnotes.la: …c est, de Ecclesia) fluunt (hoc est, emanant) aquae doctrinarum coelestium, et hoc cum impetu, id est cum quadam virtute, qua omnia haereticorum figmenta destruantur et subvertantur. Hinc et Psalmista
headnotes.en: …rh and aloe about a hundred pounds. By these trees, then, is designated the continence and chastity of the flesh. For rot is wont to designate luxury, according to what the Prophet says of certain men

headnotes.la: …tum, sciens Dominus, qui est sponsus et redemptor Ecclesiae, ipsam Ecclesiam persecutionibus multiplicandam, subsequenter ipsam quodammodo jubet venire persecutionem, non praecipiendo, sed permittendo

…Auster calidus. Et ideo per Aquilonem terrores et minae designantur, per Austrum blandimentorum decipulae. Quibus duobus modis probatur Ecclesia, terroribus videlicet et blandimentis. Quod autem dicit

…esia probetur, et illi gravius puniantur: novit enim Dominus malis hominum bona quaedam facere, sed ipsam persecutionem in potestate sua habet, ut non tantum saeviant quantum volunt. Unde scriptum est
quia videlicet flatibus persecutionum modum imponit quemdam, juxta quod Apostolus dicit
hoc est, Ecclesiam meam,
Audiens Ecclesia persecutionem vocari, tanquam se praeparans contra adversa, dicit

…um pomorum suorum, hoc est, delectetur atque pascatur bonis operibus fidelium suorum. Nam cibus Domini bona nostra opera sunt, sicut ipse fidem Samaritanorum vel gentium intuens, dixit discipulis suis
Desideranti Ecclesiae ut ad se veniat sponsus, respondet se jam hoc fecisse. Ego jam veni, nam non est imperantis

…m, sed et quotidie visito, et virtutum illius pomis pascor, atque odore fruor. Venio ad eam, ut errantes corrigam, infirmantes roborem, dubios confirmem, et perfectos quoque praemiis coelestibus donem

…ibus suis, quando sanctos martyres, vel reliquos electos bonis operibus insignes, ab hac vita falce mortis praecidit, atque ad maturitatem bonorum operum perductos, in horrea supernae patriae recondit

…imus, debemus in vino eos accipere, quorum animae jam coelesti felicitate gloriantur: in favo vero eos qui jam corpore et anima in illa beatitudine gaudent, quales sunt illi qui cum Domino surrexerunt
Non solum Dominus profectu sanctorum gaudet, verum etiam nos hortatur ut illorum virtutibus gaudeamus et illos imitemur
headnotes.en: The Church, hearing persecution called for, as though preparing herself against adversities, says

headnotes.la: …arissimi mei estis, perfecta me animi charitate diligendo. Comedite ergo, inquit, et bibite, id est sanctorum bonis actibus congaudete, et illos vobis ad imitandum proponite. Notandum vero quod dicit,
headnotes.en: …may be delighted and fed with the good works of his faithful. For the food of the Lord is our good works, as he himself, beholding the faith of the Samaritans or of the Gentiles, said to his disciples

headnotes.la: Ebrietas aliquando in Scripturis pro saturitate ponitur, sicut de fratribus Joseph dictum est
et Psalmista
headnotes.en: To the Church desiring that the bridegroom come to her, he answers that he has already done this. I have already come; for it is not

headnotes.la: …r, nec ad effectum boni operis quod audierint perducunt. Comedunt autem et saturantur qui verba vitae quae audiunt, in internis sensibus recondunt, et opere implere satagunt; de quibus Psalmista dicit
headnotes.en: … and am fed with the fruits of its virtues, and enjoy its odor. I come to it, that I may correct the erring, strengthen the sick, confirm the doubtful, and endow the perfect also with heavenly rewards

headnotes.la: …amici et charissimi ipsi sunt angelici spiritus, quos jubet Dominus congratulari electis suis, cum ab hac vita ad aeternae beatitudinis requiem transferuntur, juxta quod in evangelica parabola legitur
headnotes.en: …kle of death, the holy martyrs or the rest of the elect distinguished by good works, and, when they have been brought to the maturity of good works, stores them in the barns of the heavenly fatherland

…ught to understand by the wine those whose souls now glory in heavenly happiness; but by the honeycomb those who now rejoice in body and soul in that beatitude, such as are they who rose with the Lord

headnotes.la: Vox Ecclesiae,
headnotes.en: Not only does the Lord rejoice in the progress of the saints, but he also exhorts us to rejoice in their virtues and to imitate them

headnotes.la: …aereo, et ad illum oculos cordis mei intendo. Sed quia hoc tempus non est requiei, sed potius laboris et certaminis, rursus sponsus Ecclesiam ad labores excitat, et ad praedicationis certamen hortatur
headnotes.en: …ith perfect charity of soul. Eat, then, he says, and drink, that is, rejoice together in the good deeds of the saints, and set them before yourselves for imitation. But it is to be noted that he says,

headnotes.la: …e mortem vicinam designat. De qua pulsatione in Evangelio dicitur: Ut cum venerit et pulsaverit, confestim aperiant ei. Sed hoc loco pulsare dicitur hoc est, Ecclesiam ad opus praedicationis instigare
headnotes.en: : inebriation is sometimes put in the Scriptures for fullness, as it was said of the brethren of Joseph
and the Psalmist

headnotes.la: Soror, quia cohaeres es regni mei facta
headnotes.en: … effect of good work what they have heard. But they eat and are filled who store the words of life which they hear in their inward senses, and strive to fulfill them in deed; of whom the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: quia de jugo servitutis liberata arcana veritatis meae cognovisti
headnotes.en: …the angelic spirits themselves, whom the Lord bids to congratulate his elect, when they are transferred from this life to the rest of eternal beatitude, according to what is read in the Gospel parable

headnotes.la: quia spiritus mei dote es sanctificata
quia effusione mei sanguinis ab omni peccatorum macula purgata es
headnotes.en: The voice of the Church,

headnotes.la: hoc est, de quiete et otio dilectae tibi contemplationis egredere ad opus praedicationis
headnotes.en: …he eyes of my heart toward him. But because this is a time not of rest, but rather of labor and struggle, again the bridegroom rouses the Church to labors, and exhorts her to the struggle of preaching

…ar. Of which knocking it is said in the Gospel: That when he comes and knocks, they may open to him at once. But in this place to knock means this, namely to incite the Church to the work of preaching

headnotes.la: Provocata Ecclesia a sponso suo ad officium praedicationis, respondet

…nis adaptat suscipiendum, debet quoque temporalia subditis providere, quae sine magna sollicitudine agi non possunt. Quod autem tunica sollicitudines et curas significet, Dominus ostendit in Evangelio
headnotes.en: Sister, because thou art made co-heir of my kingdom

headnotes.la: …rum occupationibus saeculi implicetur. Timet ergo Ecclesia, vel anima quaeque sancta, hac tunica exui, et in contemplatione sui Conditoris requiescens, iterum reindui et saecularibus negotiis occupari
headnotes.en: because, freed from the yoke of servitude, thou hast come to know the secrets of my truth

headnotes.la: Lavi pedes meos, hoc est, actiones quibus nunquam pulverem tangere, hoc est, terrena agere consueveram, dignis poenitentiae fletibus ablui, adeo ut nihil nunc nisi divina me libeat cogitare
headnotes.en: because thou art sanctified by the dowry of my Spirit
because by the shedding of my blood thou art purged from every stain of sins

headnotes.la: …a cogitare incipimus, cordis nostri arcana se concutiunt, dum stupere incipimus, quanta dignatione haec Conditor pro nobis agere dignatus est. Nam quod venter cor significet, ostendit Propheta, dicens
headnotes.en: that is, go forth from the quiet and leisure of the contemplation dear to thee, to the work of preaching

headnotes.la: Quod quid esset ostendit, dicens

headnotes.en: The Church, called forth by her bridegroom to the office of preaching, answers

headnotes.la: …scipimus, verum etiam cum aliis praedicamus, et eos qui per malitiam pectus clauserant, nostra praedicatione conversos, facimus ut ipsi quoque januam cordis Christo aperiant. Bene autem primo dicitur,
headnotes.en: …ice of preaching ought also to provide temporal things for his subjects, which cannot be done without great solicitude. But that the tunic signifies solicitudes and cares, the Lord shows in the Gospel

headnotes.la: deinde,
headnotes.en: …upations of the world. The Church, then, or any holy soul, fears to be stripped of this tunic, and, resting in the contemplation of her Creator, to be reclothed again and occupied with worldly affairs

headnotes.la: …a Christo vult aperire, prius debet surgere, hoc est ad studium bonorum operum erigi, et opere implere quod praedicat, ne forte aliis praedicans ipse reprobus efficiatur. Hinc et Lucas de Domino dicit
headnotes.en: …ons with which I was never wont to touch the dust, that is, to do earthly things, I have washed with worthy weeping of penance, so much so that now nothing pleases me but to think on the divine things

headnotes.la: Prius dicit

headnotes.en: …laces of our heart are shaken, while we begin to be amazed with how great condescension the Creator deigned to do these things for us. For that the belly signifies the heart, the Prophet shows, saying

headnotes.la: …membro tantae sunt distinctiones articulorum, quantae in digitis. Manus Ecclesiae myrrham stillant, cum praedicatores ejus continentiae et mortificationi carnis suae operam dant, dicentes cum Apostolo
headnotes.en: And what this was he shows, saying

headnotes.la: Sive cum pro Christo mori parati sunt, sicut Joannes dicit

…manis favoribus jejunat, vel abstinentiae sive continentiae operibus insistit, in manibus quidem myrrham habet, sed in digitis non habet, quia non discernit quare hoc faciat. De qualibus Dominus dicit
headnotes.en: …preach to others, and make those who through malice had closed their breast, converted by our preaching, that they themselves also open the door of their heart to Christ. But rightly is it first said,

headnotes.la: Pessulum ostii aperit, cum Ecclesia vel fidelis quaeque anima cor advenienti Conditori pandit
Plerumque enim cum spiritualia quaeque tractare volumus, quanto subtilius intendimus, tanto acies cordis reverberatur. Unde Salomon dicit
Psalmista quoque dicit
Quanto enim quisque magis ad contemplationem divinam purificatione carnis cor sustollit, tanto altius quod quaerebat esse invenit. Dicit ergo
quia nemo eum in praesenti vita sicuti est comprehendere potest

…emoritur, et quasi insensibilis mundo efficitur, solumque coelesti desiderio vivit. Hoc est quod etiam per prophetam dicitur: Quis caecus nisi servus meus? Quis surdus, nisi ad quem nuntios meos misi?

…ensurum promittit, vel etiam non respondet, id est non exaudit, ad hoc ut libito suo sanctus quisque vinculis corporis exuatur, et liber amplexibus sponsi sui demulceatur. Nam quando Apostolus dicebat

… desideria accendant. Inveniunt ergo sponsam dilectum quaerentem, cum sancti doctores animam coelestibus desideriis intentam, vel praesentes verbo, vel absentes Scripturis suis instituunt et informant
headnotes.en: One opens the bolt of the door, when the Church, or any faithful soul, throws open the heart to the coming Creator

headnotes.la: Verbum Dei gladius est, dicente Apostolo
headnotes.en: For very often, when we wish to treat of any spiritual things, the more subtly we strain, the more the edge of the heart is beaten back. Whence Solomon says

headnotes.la: Hoc gladio sponsa percutitur et vulneratur, quando praedicatoris sermo de Deo loquitur, et auditores veluti quodam spiculo compunctionis et amoris transfodit
headnotes.en: The Psalmist too says

headnotes.la: Hoc hic pallium, quod superius tunica intelligitur, ubi dicitur
headnotes.en: For the more anyone lifts up his heart to divine contemplation by the purification of the flesh, the higher he finds that to be which he was seeking. He says therefore

headnotes.la: …ferunt, quia quidquid de amore praesentis saeculi in mente alicujus remanserit, totum sancti doctores auferunt, et eam solummodo sponsum Christum diligere faciunt. Hi tales possunt dicere cum Apostolo
headnotes.en: because no one in the present life can comprehend him as he is

…s it were insensible to the world, and lives by heavenly desire alone. This is what is also said through the prophet: Who is blind but my servant? Who is deaf but he to whom I have sent my messengers?

…hears not, to this end, that at his good pleasure every holy one may be stripped of the bonds of the body, and, being free, may be caressed by the embraces of his bridegroom. For when the Apostle said

headnotes.la: …eri. Bene autem se amore languere dicit: quanto enim magis superna desiderare coeperit, tanto erga ea quae mundi sunt, languescit. Nec mirum si tales languere dicuntur, cum Apostolus eos mortuos dicat

headnotes.en: …eavenly desires. They find, then, the bride seeking her beloved, when the holy teachers instruct and form the soul intent on heavenly desires, either present by their word, or absent by their writings

headnotes.la: …. Tu ergo quae illum jam amore quaeris, ejusque amore langues, dic mihi qualis est dilectus tuus ex dilecto. Dilectus ex dilecto, Filius est ex Patre, sicut est Deus de Deo, lumen de lumine. Vel etiam
headnotes.en: The word of God is a sword, the Apostle saying
By this sword the bride is struck and wounded, when the word of the preacher speaks of God, and pierces the hearers as with a certain dart of compunction and love

headnotes.la: Vox respondentis Ecclesiae
headnotes.en: This cloak here, which above is understood as the tunic, where it is said

headnotes.la: candidus virginitate, rubicundus passione. Candidus, quia sine peccato; nam sine peccato est conversatus
headnotes.en: …ke away, because whatever remains in anyone's mind of the love of the present world, the holy teachers take it all away, and make him love only the bridegroom Christ. Such men can say with the Apostle

headnotes.la: quia
quia « lavit nos a peccatis nostris in sanguine suo
headnotes.en: …r the more she begins to desire the heavenly things, the more she languishes toward the things that are of the world. Nor is it a wonder if such are said to languish, since the Apostle calls them dead

headnotes.la: Singulari enim gratia homo Christus in omni humani generis massa refulsit, quia per illum proposuit Deus salvare genus humanum, et ipse est mediator Dei et hominum Jesus Christus; de quo Psalmista
Et Salomon
headnotes.en: …ishest with love of him, tell me what manner of one thy beloved is above another beloved. The beloved above another beloved is the Son from the Father, as he is God from God, light from light. Or also

headnotes.la: id est Christum, et ipse in psalmo

headnotes.en: The voice of the answering Church

headnotes.la: quia ex omni multitudine sanctorum solus dignus fuit audire
headnotes.en: : white by virginity, ruddy by his passion. White, because without sin; for he lived without sin

headnotes.la: Caput sponsi Deus est, juxta quod Apostolus dicit,
headnotes.en: because

headnotes.la: quod auro optimo comparatur, quia sicut aurum omnibus metallis pretiosius est, ita Deus omnipotens a se factis bonis praecellit et supereminet. Unde Dominus
Caput ergo sponsi aurum optimum est, quia Dei bonitas est ineffabilis, omnium rerum bonitatem transcendens, quia nihil bonum, nisi participatione hujus summi boni
headnotes.en: … Christ shone forth in the whole mass of the human race, because through him God purposed to save the human race, and he himself is the mediator of God and men, Jesus Christ; of whom the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: …aeterna desideranda extolluntur, atque dulcedinem supernae suavitatis degustant, quam quanto magis percipiunt, tanto magis in oculis suis peccatores sibi et contemptibiles esse videntur. Unde sequitur
headnotes.en: And Solomon

headnotes.la: Comae enim sponsi nigrae sunt quasi corvus, quia fidelium multitudines suae fragilitatis sibi consciae sunt, et nihil se boni ex se habere noverunt. Vel etiam
headnotes.en: that is, Christ; and he himself in the psalm

headnotes.la: sunt in spe et victoria
Oculi ejus dona sunt Spiritus sancti. Quod ostendit Joannes in Apocalypsi, dicens

…is et sinceris mentibus delectatur. Non enim super stagna vel paludes, sed super rivulos aquarum columbae resident, quia (ut dictum est) Spiritus sanctus castas et mundas mentes sibi habitaculum facit

…tatem. Hae columbae super rivulos resident, ut adventum accipitris a longe prospiciant et praecaveant, sic et sancti doctores aqua baptismatis perfusi, nitore castitatis et sanctimoniae dealbati sunt,

…re ipsa delectabat, et ad sui dilectionem provocabat. Hae areolae a pigmentariis consitae sunt. Pigmentarii sunt prophetae vel apostoli, quorum alteri haec omnia futura, alteri jam facta descripserunt

…ni comparantur, quia castitatis illa et munditiae opera docent. Distillant primam myrrham, quia quaecunque adversa patienter perferenda insinuant. Labia Domini lilia erant, cum docens in monte diceret
Distillant myrrham primam, cum post haec subjungeret

…amque sponsi, digne operatio Salvatoris accipitur. Sicut enim quis torno facile operatur, nec regula ulla indiget, sic operatio Salvatoris facilis erat: quidquid enim volebat, illico perficiebat, quia
headnotes.en: His eyes are the gifts of the Holy Spirit. Which John shows in the Apocalypse, saying

headnotes.la: et de quo Evangelista,
headnotes.en: … sincere minds. For the doves settle not upon pools or marshes, but upon the little streams of waters, because (as has been said) the Holy Spirit makes for himself a dwelling of chaste and clean minds

headnotes.la: …illius divinitatis peragebatur potentia: nam in auro divinitas figuratur, quia sicut aurum caetera metalla antecellit, et pretiosius est, ita divinitas suis omnibus operibus ineffabili modo praecellit
headnotes.en: … that they may from afar look out for and beware of the coming of the hawk; so also the holy teachers, poured over with the water of baptism, are whitened with the brightness of chastity and holiness,

headnotes.la: …ae sunt hyacinthis, quia in cruce clavis perforatae, et rubore sui sanguinis quasi colore purpureo respersae sunt. Sed superior expositio de hyacintho lapide, melius hic convenit. In alia translatione
habetur. Dicuntur enim manus ejus tornatiles, plenae tharsis. Tharsis lapis est quem nos chalcedonium dicimus
headnotes.en: …ed them to his love. These beds are set by the perfumers. The perfumers are the prophets or the apostles, of whom the one described all these things as things to come, the other as things already done

headnotes.la: … in eo ullus. Fragilitatem quidem carnis assumpsit, sed tamen totius peccati immunis fuit, sicut serpens aeneus a Moyse in deserto exaltatus, figuram quidem serpentis habuit, sed malitia veneni caruit
