headnotes.en: … of chastity and purity. They drip the first myrrh, because they insinuate that whatever adversities are to be patiently endured. The lips of the Lord were lilies, when, teaching on the mount, he said

headnotes.la: Sapphirus lapis est, coeli sereni habens colorem, unde in visione Domini dicitur
headnotes.en: They drip the first myrrh, when after these he added

headnotes.la: …nae majestatis intelliguntur, quae in carne perficiuntur. Venter ergo sponsi distinctus erat sapphiris, quia humanitas Christi coelestibus virtutibus refulgebat. Nec plenus dicitur esse sapphiris, sed

headnotes.en: …groom is fitly taken the working of the Savior. For as one easily works with a lathe, and needs no rule, so the working of the Savior was easy: for whatever he willed, he at once accomplished, because

headnotes.la: …armoreis comparantur, quia nihil marmore fortius, nihil columna rectius. Et crura sponsi columnae marmoreae sunt, quia omnia itinera Domini et fortia et recta sunt. De ejus fortitudine dicit Psalmista
headnotes.en: and of whom the Evangelist says,

headnotes.la: De rectitudine alibi
headnotes.en: …by the power of the divinity: for in gold the divinity is figured, because as gold surpasses the other metals and is more precious, so the divinity surpasses all its own works in an unspeakable manner

headnotes.la: et,
headnotes.en: …oss they were pierced by nails, and were sprinkled by the redness of his own blood as with a purple color. But the former exposition of the hyacinth as a stone fits better here. In another translation

headnotes.la: …mysteria quibus humanum genus redimeretur. Unde et Propheta laudans Deum dicebat: Domine Deus meus, honorificabo te, laudes dicam nomini tuo qui facis mirabiles res: consilium tuum antiquum verum fiat

Et deosculer te, inquit, id est, manifesta te aspiciam visione, quem nunc tantum in fidei teneo osculo, quod initio hujus carminis optavit, dicens

…appareat. Quasi enim per prophetas osculabatur Ecclesiam dilectus, cum adventum suum per eos repromitteret. Optat ergo ut per seipsum veniens illam osculetur, hoc est in carne sua praesentiam exhibeat

headnotes.en: …nd, turned into an infant, should suck the breasts of his mother? It is, therefore, the voice of that Church which preceded the coming of Christ, whom we call the Synagogue (that is, the congregation)

headnotes.la: …bi adhaerendo, ducam te in domum matris meae. Mater Ecclesiae, hoc loco coelestis Hierusalem intelligitur, de qua Paulus dicit: Illa autem quae sursum est Hierusalem, libera est, quae est mater nostra
headnotes.en: … grant that thou be made man, and, existing as a partaker and sharer of my nature, be called my brother? For he himself deigned to call himself the brother of the apostles, saying through the Psalmist

headnotes.la: …uit, pro eo quod est, deducam et prosequar, quia ascendentem Dominum in coelos apostoli oculis deduxerunt, et quousque eum nubes suscepit, pio aspectu prosecuti sunt, donec angeli assistentes dixerunt
headnotes.en: And after the resurrection to the women,
he said,

headnotes.la: Hoc ad superiora refertur, ubi dicitur

…o, ibi docebis me, quia ad omnia quae interrogare voluero, respondebis. Nam saepe etiam volentes interrogare apostolos Dominus praeveniebat, eosque instruebat. Potest et ad hunc locum jungi, ubi dicit
headnotes.en: … that is, fulfilling all things that belong to human nature, sin excepted. For the mother of the Synagogue is understood in this place to be human nature itself, from which the Synagogue itself sprang

headnotes.la: … me quoque in coelum tecum assumpseris, ibi me docebis, et in omnem veritatem induces, quod impossibile est homini in praesinti vita posse consequi; hinc est quod Dominus repromittit apostolis, dicens
headnotes.en: that is, enduring all things that pertain to human frailty

headnotes.la: Ergo ibi me docebis, id est, te et Patrem mihi aperta visione revelabis, hoc est, divinitatem tuam mihi facie ad faciem ostendes
headnotes.en: …n he yet lay hidden in the bosom of the paternal majesty, but he was found without, when, made man, he offered himself as lowly offspring to men, and, being incomprehensible, willed to be comprehended

headnotes.la: … amor Dei, sicut beatus Gregorius dicit, nunquam est otiosus, operatur magna si est. Si enim operari renuit, amor non est. Vinum enim conditum est dilectio cum operatione. Unde et Dominus in Evangelio
headnotes.en: And I may kiss thee, he says, that is, I may behold with manifest vision him whom now I hold only in the kiss of faith — which she desired at the beginning of this song, saying

headnotes.la: Probatio dilectionis exhibitio est operis
headnotes.en: …sed the Church through the prophets, when he promised his coming through them. She desires, therefore, that, coming through himself, he may kiss her, that is, may display his presence in his own flesh

…d thee into the house of my mother. The mother of the Church, in this place, is understood as the heavenly Jerusalem, of which Paul says: But that Jerusalem which is above is free, which is our mother

headnotes.la: …aciant dilectam, hoc est, ne illam in somno dulcissimae quietis positam, hoc est, in contemplatione sui Conditoris sua inquietudine excitent, et ad sollicitudines et curas saeculi evigilare compellant
headnotes.en: …nd follow after," because the apostles conducted with their eyes the Lord ascending into heaven, and with devout gaze followed after him until the cloud received him, until the angels standing by said

headnotes.la: …ndit de deserto? Derelicta enim fuerat a Deo per idololatriam et veritatis ignorantiam. Ascendebat ergo virtutum gradibus de deserto, hoc est de errore infidelitatis, in quo ad tempus derelicta fuerat
headnotes.en: This is referred to the words above, where it is said

headnotes.la: id est virtutibus abundans
headnotes.en: …me, because to all that I shall wish to ask, thou wilt answer. For often the Lord anticipated even the apostles wishing to ask, and instructed them. It can also be joined to this place, where she says

headnotes.la: id est, fiducialiter agens in Christo, et omnes virtutes suas et cuncta bona ad ejus gratiam referens, sciebat se nihil suis viribus boni implere posse, ideoque cum Apostolo dicens
headnotes.en: …hee into heaven, there thou shalt teach me, and lead me into all truth, which is impossible for man in the present life to be able to attain; hence it is that the Lord promises to the apostles, saying

headnotes.la: Et notandum quod dicit, Super dilectum meum. Nam Synagoga solam putabat se habere cognitionem Dei, caeteris gentibus in ignorantia destitutis
headnotes.en: Therefore there thou shalt teach me, that is, thou wilt reveal to me, in open vision, thee and the Father, that is, thou wilt show me thy divinity face to face

headnotes.la: ut ait Psalmista,
headnotes.en: …d, as blessed Gregory says, is never idle; it works great things if it be present. For if it refuses to work, it is not love. For spiced wine is love with operation. Whence also the Lord in the Gospel
The proof of love is the showing of the work

headnotes.la: …peccati et potestate diaboli per crucem Christi redempta est, ibi suscitata est quae peccatis mortua erat. Et bene arborem mali dicit. Nam, ut supra dictum est, huic arbori Christum comparavit, dicens

…bae et Pharisaei, qui Christum Pilato tradiderunt, qui reliquam plebem tanquam mater et genitrix regere debebant et erudire, et quales erant illi qui suadentibus illis principibus, improbe acclamabant
headnotes.en: …hat is, that they rouse not her — set in the sleep of most sweet rest, that is, in the contemplation of her Maker — by their disquiet, and compel her to awake to the solicitudes and cares of the world

headnotes.la: Haec ergo mater Synagogae sub arbore malo corrupta est et violata, quando se suosque posteros crudeli maledictione constrinxit, dicens

…et ut recte in illum credentes, fidem ipsam bonis operibus exornemus. Quod si fecerimus, ipse quoque nos velut signaculum assumet, et nostri recordabitur, juxta quod Zorobabel duci Judaeae repromittit
Nam si nos beneficiorum ejus obliti fuerimus, nec ei dignas gratiarum actiones retulerimus, ipse quoque nostri obliviscetur, sicut de impio rege Jechonia filio Joachim dicitur

…a homini licet ambire, ita dilectio Christi quem vere pervaserit, totum huic saeculo mortificat, et quasi insensibilem reddit, solumque pro Christo vivens, mundo mortuus est. Idem sensus est cum dicit
Nam sicut infernus eos quos semel recipit nunquam restituit, sed semper retinet, ita verus Christi amor quem semel acceperit, nunquam dimittit; unde Apostolus dicit

…it misereri aut a poenis miserorum mitigari, sic et Christi dilectio non potuit a misericordia cessare, aut ullis improbitatibus persecutorum removeri ab amore humani generis. Quidam hoc quod dicitur,
ad Synagogam proprie referunt, quae gentes aemulabatur, et invidebat saluti eorum. Monet ergo Christus hoc dicens, ut ab invidia cesset, et saluti Ecclesiae congaudeat

…lumina sunt violentae persecutorum minae, vel etiam blandimenta, quibus sanctos a charitate Dei separare nituntur. De quibus Dominus in Evangelio dicit, de viro qui aedificavit domum suam supra petram
quia nulla tribulatio, nulla angustia sanctos a charitate Dei separare valebit
headnotes.en: … believing in him, may adorn that very faith with good works. And if we do this, he too will take us up as a seal, and will remember us, according to what he promises to Zerubbabel the leader of Judea

headnotes.la: …d tamen nihil sibi videbantur dimittere in comparatione charitatis Christi, quem amabant. Unde Apostolus cum non solum terrenam substantiam, sed et paternas traditiones dimitteret pro Christo, dicebat
headnotes.en: For if we have forgotten his benefits, and have not rendered him worthy thanksgivings, he too will forget us, as is said of the impious king Jeconiah the son of Joachim

headnotes.la: Vox dilecti Synagogam alloquentis pro Ecclesia gentium
headnotes.en: …t, which has truly pervaded anyone, mortifies him wholly to this world, and renders him as it were insensible, and, living for Christ alone, he is dead to the world. The same is the sense when he says

headnotes.la: inquit, id est gentium Ecclesia,
headnotes.en: For just as hell never restores those whom it once receives, but ever retains them, so the true love of Christ, which it has once received, it never lets go; whence the Apostle says

headnotes.la: et magna dignatione communicato cum Synagoga nomine dicit,
headnotes.en: … the punishments of the wretched, so also the love of Christ could not cease from mercy, or by any wickednesses of persecutors be removed from the love of the human race. Some refer this that is said,

headnotes.la: quia enim ex Judaeis carnem assumpsit, ideo se quasi Synagogae contemperat et exaequat
headnotes.en: …o the Synagogue, which was jealous of the nations, and envied their salvation. Christ therefore admonishes by saying this, that she cease from envy, and rejoice together at the salvation of the Church

headnotes.la: …emporibus, quia et parvitate credentium parva exsistebat; et ubera necdum habebat, id est nequaquam praedicando spirituales Deo filios generare valebat. Dicit ergo quasi consilium Synagogae requirens,

headnotes.en: …eats of persecutors, or also the enticements, by which they strive to separate the saints from the love of God. Of which the Lord says in the Gospel, concerning the man who built his house upon a rock

headnotes.la: … praestantes, quasi alios defendere et munire possint vice muri, aedificemus super hunc talem murum propugnacula argentea, id est, addamus illis eloquia divinarum Scripturarum. Nam, ut Psalmista dicit

…et ligna, id est immarcescibilia opera habent, et veluti tabulae scientiae et charitatis latitudine diffusi sunt. Latitudo enim tabularum latitudinem cordis vel scientiae significat, dicente Psalmista
headnotes.en: because no tribulation, no distress, will be able to separate the saints from the love of God

…to themselves to leave nothing in comparison with the charity of Christ, whom they loved. Whence the Apostle, when he left not only earthly substance, but also the paternal traditions for Christ, said

headnotes.la: Vox Ecclesiae. Quae cum audisset pro sua salute consulentem dilectum suum, ipsa laeta respondit
Ego (inquit) murus, ego supra firmam petram fundata sum, et glutine divinae charitatis solidata. Sive murus sum, quia de vivis et electis lapidibus (hoc est sanctis) aedificata sum;
headnotes.en: It is the voice of the beloved, speaking to the Synagogue on behalf of the Church of the nations

headnotes.la: …icut turres in muro eminent, sic merito doctrinae et conversationis inter reliquos membra mea praecellunt. Hoc autem non meis meritis, neque libertate mei arbitrii habeo, sed dono et gratia sponsi mei
headnotes.en: he says, that is, the Church of the nations,
and with great condescension, the name being shared with the Synagogue, he says,

headnotes.la: …erra. Unde, et a Propheta Pater futuri saeculi, princeps pacis appellatur, in cujus veri pacifici typo Salomon pacificus, auctor hujus carminis praecessit. Huic ergo fuit vinea, id est sancta Ecclesia
headnotes.en: because he assumed flesh from the Jews, therefore he tempers himself, as it were, to the Synagogue and makes himself its equal

headnotes.la: …it ut se de Ecclesia gentium, non de Synagoga, ostenderet canere. Nam Synagoga unius gentis fuit tantum. Ecclesia vero habet populos, quia omnes gentes intra capacissimum suum gremium capit et recipit
headnotes.en: … believers she was little; and she had not yet breasts, that is, she was by no means able, by preaching, to beget spiritual sons to God. He says, therefore, as if seeking the counsel of the Synagogue,

headnotes.la: …d est sanctae Ecclesiae) sunt prophetae, apostoli apostolorumque successores. Sive etiam custodes hujus saeculi sunt angelicae virtutes, quae ab incursibus tentationum et daemonum Ecclesiam custodiunt

…ineae mille argenteos affert, quia sancti omnia sua relinquunt, et pauperibus erogant, ut fructum hujus vineae (hoc est, supernam mercedem) consequantur. Tale est illud quod Dominus in Evangelio dicit
headnotes.en: …were defend and fortify others in the stead of a wall — let us build upon such a wall bulwarks of silver, that is, let us add to them the eloquences of the divine Scriptures. For, as the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: …vinea semper coram me est, quia licet eam custodibus meis commiserim, ego tamen semper curam illius habeo, nec pro illa semper sollicitus esse desisto, sed sum cum illa usque ad consummationem saeculi

… vivendo semetipsos custodiunt, et etiam praedicando alios convertunt. His ergo talibus ducenti argentei sunt pacifici, quia duplicata in coelis eis manet remuneratio. De qualibus per Danielem dicitur
Hos enim Apostolus dupliciter jubet honorari, dicens

…rius dictum est) crebro se promittit invisere. Ecclesia ergo in hortis habitat, quia plantaria virtutum assidue nutrit, nec transitorie modicum recessura, ibi tugurium ponit, sed fixa statione habitat

…, praecepta meae legis simul et promissum coelestium praemiorum annuntia. Hoc enim mihi jucundum et delectabile est, ut audiam vocem tuam, hoc est ut audiam te verba salutis aeternae annuntiantem. Sed

…itatur ad praedicandum, et ut sponsus audiat vocem ejus, illa vero hortatur sponsum suum ut fugiat. Sed magna est mysterii consequentia. Nam quia superius praedicta fuerat Christi nativitas, cum dixit
Praedicta enim fuerat ejus passio, ubi dictum est

… coelum, ut non jam te sicut hominem, sed sicut Deum super omnia cogitare incipiam. Tunc enim audies vocem meam, quia tunc te liberius omni mundo praedicabo. Et hoc est quod Dominus in Evangelio dicit

…ut Deum invisibilem et ubique praesentem cogitare. At postquam ipse coelos ascendit, coepit eum Ecclesia spiritualiter diligere, et sic jam Deum cogitare et praedicare. Et hoc est quod Apostolus dicit
headnotes.en: …before me, because, although I have committed it to my keepers, I nevertheless always have care of it, nor do I ever cease to be solicitous for it, but I am with it even to the consummation of the age

headnotes.la: …mprehensibilis per divinitatem, verumtamen ne me in praesenti sine tua visitatione deseras, sed dignare me crebra tua visitatione requirere, mihique te saepius videndum praebere. Et hoc est quod dicit
headnotes.en: …selves, and also, by preaching, convert others. To such, then, the two hundred pieces of silver are at peace, because a doubled recompense awaits them in the heavens. Of such it is said through Daniel

headnotes.la: …uper montes aromatum. Montes aromatum sancti Dei sunt, excellentia sanctae conversationis coelo proximi, et odore ac fama virtutum longe lateque fragrantes. Hinc Apostolus de se suique similibus dicit
headnotes.en: For the Apostle commands these to be doubly honored, saying

headnotes.la: Et alibi
